From the altar of Kreupasanam, where our Mother appeared alive, and from her altar,
for allowing me to testify as a witness to Mother's apparition, I offer a thousand thanks to Jesus and Our Lady of Kreupasanam.
My name is Neethu, and I come from St. Joseph's Parish in Thiruvananthapuram.
This is my son, Emmanuel, and I am standing here to testify about a miraculous healing he received.
This is my mother-in-law, and this is my eldest daughter, Ivana.
I made my first Covenant in 2022, and after that, in 2023, I was able to travel to the UK with my family.
A year after arriving there, in 2024, I became pregnant for the second time.
I was working as a home carer there, and because of that, I had to travel a lot.
To get from one house to another, I had to travel by bus for an hour,
or two, so when I became pregnant for the second time, it was very difficult for me.
So I prayed to Our Mother, saying, "Mother..." this pregnancy was completely unexpected.
I don't know what to do next or how to move forward, as our company is not very supportive.
It was very difficult to even get a day off; we could only get emergency leave if we arranged cover for ourselves.
Since I was working in such a company, I was very worried about how I would manage.
Then, I took a picture of Our Lady of Kreupasanam that I had, and I stood before Mother and prayed.
"Mother, I don't know how to go on or what to do," I said, and seeking comfort, I took the Bible and read it.
The verse I received was Isaiah chapter 7, verse 14.
"Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel."
I was so amazed when I received this verse, because it was so closely related to my life.
I felt great courage, realizing it was proof that Blessed Mother was with me.
With that courage, I moved forward.
According to this verse, I told my husband, since there we can find out the baby's gender in the fifth month during the scan.
"Based on this verse, I know Jesus is giving me a baby boy."
Accordingly, I decided to name him just as the verse said.
And when my son was born, I named him Emmanuel, and so time went on.
I went to the hospital for my first scan, and at that time, there were no issues.
Every time I went for a scan, I would use the Covenant oil, and make the sign of the cross on my womb.
While reciting the Creed, I would make the sign of the cross. I would drink the blessed water with salt, and sprinkle the salt in the scanning room.
I always recited the Creed before entering.
The first time, everything was perfectly fine, and then I went for my second scan.
Before that, I used to have a lot of fear due to all the traveling for work.
As I had to change two or three buses and walk fast, I would pray, "Mother, I am terrified, will something happen to my baby?"
I told Mother, "Even though the baby is in my womb, I entrust him into your hands."
"You alone must protect my child." Entrusting him to her, I went for my scans.
The first scan was fine, but during the second scan, they said that because the baby was moving so much,
they couldn't see his right kidney, so they suggested we do one more scan.
When I asked the doctor, they said it was normal and sometimes hard to see.
They assured me it should be visible in the next scan. So I went for the next scan.
Knowing Blessed Mother was with me, I wasn't too afraid, fully believing that the right kidney would be visible this time.
I went in, and the doctor examined me thoroughly.
When they looked at the left side, we could see the blood flow, the red and blue veins, but when they checked the right side, it was completely dark.
The doctor told me that the baby's right kidney had not developed, and only the left one was there.
They said it was okay, that children with only one kidney can live normal lives just like other children.
They reassured me that there were no other issues and nothing to fear.
In my mind, I wanted to ask, "We have more scans, will we be able to see it later?"
The doctor explained that a tissue forms at a specific time, and the kidney develops from that.
Since that time had passed, the doctor firmly stated that it was impossible for it to develop now.
They also confirmed during the scan that it was a boy.
They told me that because he is a boy, there wouldn't be many issues, whereas if it were a girl, there could be complications as she grows up.
Hearing all this made me incredibly sad, and I cried out to Our Mother.
"Mother, didn't I entrust my baby to you? Then why did this happen to him?" I wept bitterly.
We all know that even for people with two kidneys, if a problem arises, it is very difficult.
So, I agonized over what might happen in the future to a child with only one kidney.
I was heartbroken and prayed to Mother with tears.
During every Covenant retreat, I would pray weeping, and every day I would make the sign of the cross on my womb with the Covenant oil.
Whenever I found the time, I would recite the Apparition Prayer.
I always placed this one intention, "Mother, please give me my baby's right kidney."
The truth was, the doctor had declared it would never develop.
But I don't know why, I only felt like praying for that, so I told Mother, "Mother, you yourself must give me my baby's right kidney."
I prayed fervently, participating in the Covenant retreat every Tuesday, and praying.
Likewise, I made the sign of the cross daily with the Covenant oil, and I went to every scan with immense hope.
Even up to the very last scan, all the reports kept showing that the right kidney was missing.
Eventually, they scheduled my C-section.
My delivery date was set for March 1st, the delivery went well, and they brought the baby to my room.
I immediately took the Covenant oil that I had with me, made the sign of the cross on his right side, and prayed.
Afterwards, the doctor told me, "We will give you an appointment for the baby's follow-up."
"They will advise you on the dietary restrictions, since missing a kidney requires strict diet management and careful control over what foods to avoid."
They told me they would arrange a doctor's appointment for that.
I went home with a heavy heart,
Yet I prayed, "Let Jesus' will be done" and I held fast to Mother. Even at home, during the time of Adoration, I would lift my son up.
When the priest prayed during Adoration, I would show him to the Lord, praying.
I made the sign of the cross on his right side with the Covenant oil.
I would also place the covenant medal on him and pray.
He was born on March 1st, and they gave us an appointment date for April 7th at 2:40 PM.
I didn't take much note of the time then, and we went for the scan.
But before that, we had gone to get his BCG vaccine.
At that time, they asked if the baby had any underlying medical conditions, which we had to fill out on a form.
I felt so devastated, and tears filled my eyes as I had to write down that he was missing a kidney.
Thinking about it made me weep, and I cried out, "Mother, I never expected a situation like this."
"Though we've faced financial struggles in life, an ordeal like this is something I simply cannot bear."
I filled out that form through my tears, and then the day came for the scan.
Just as before, I prayed using the Covenant oil on him.
I always kept the miraculous medal tightly in my hand wherever I went.
When going to the hospital, I would plead, "Mother, you must come with me."
Just like holding one's mother by the hand, that is how I constantly held onto the covenant medal.
Gripping it, I took my son for this scan, and I had often told my husband before.
We have heard of so many miracles and testimonies of healing,
but until today, I had never heard a testimony about a missing organ miraculously appearing.
While I was thinking this, right before this, I happened to see a testimony.
A child born without a uterus received one through the Covenant by the grace of Jesus.
When I watched that, my faith increased tremendously, knowing truly, nothing is impossible for Jesus.
So, we went for the baby's follow-up scan, and they laid the baby down.
I held the covenant medal tightly and sprinkled the Covenant salt right next to the baby.
They asked me, "Which kidney is missing?" and I told them, "It's the one on the right side."
They replied, "Let's check the right side first to see what's happening."
As they started scanning, they looked at the screen and said to me with great joy, "The baby's kidney is right here!"
Then they checked the left side, and when we looked at both sides, we could clearly see the blue and red veins.
The first time we had checked, it was just darkness on the right side.
But at this moment, we were able to see those veins beautifully on both sides.
I firmly believe with all my heart that Our Lady of Kreupasanam blessed me with this, as it is truly the immense grace of Blessed Mother.
I offer a thousand thanks to her for this mighty blessing received through the intercession of the Mother of Kreupasanam.
While I was there, my apostolic work was distributing the Kreupasanam newsletters, which I had taken with me from here.
For the first time, I went to a church located near the hotel where we were initially staying, and I gave it to the people there.
I had made a promise to Mother that I would distribute the newsletters there as soon as I arrived.
I kept my word to Mother and was able to distribute it.
I told everyone that this was a place where Blessed Mother had appeared, and I gave the newsletters to them all.
Similarly, because I was a home carer, in the houses I visited, whenever sick patients complained of pain.
I would use the Covenant oil and make the sign of the cross, and pray over the areas where they felt discomfort.
Likewise, there was a man in a wheelchair who suffered from severe depression and felt useless.
When he spoke like that, I would tell him, "Jesus is with you, why are you saying such things? Shall I read the Bible to you?"
When he showed interest, he would say yes, and if not, I would gently ask him later if he was interested, offering to read.
Sometimes he agreed, other times he declined.
But eventually, he began asking me directly, "Mary, can you read the Bible for me?" Whenever he felt like it, he would ask me himself.
Later, when my sister came from back home, she brought me the Kreupasanam newsletters again, which I distributed in the homes of the patients I cared for.
I joyfully shared the newsletters with everyone, telling them about Blessed Mother's apparition there.
Also, I couldn't do many acts of mercy there,
so I ministered to the patients I was attending to in that way.
Speaking of my spiritual life, when I went there, even though I used to go for Holy Mass before, I hadn't given it that much importance.
But after making this Covenant and going there, the church would be about an hour's distance away, and I would have to walk.
Still, even if it was cold or raining and I could have just stayed home, I couldn't do that.
Whatever the weather was, I would walk all that distance and participate in the Holy Mass.
Similarly, sometimes they would assign me duty on Sundays, and at those times, if I went in the morning, there would be an evening Mass.
I would come and attend that Holy Mass.
After leaving from here, I lived a life of Covenant, and even though I couldn't renew the Covenant online,
I would write down my intentions on a paper and renew it myself every three months.
I would write down my sins on a paper and pray over it,
and that is how I kept renewing my Covenant, so even there, I was leading the same Covenant life.
Earlier, I used to have many intentions,
but just as Father taught us, when I prayed for my baby to get a kidney, I would say, "Mother, make me a witness to your apparition through this,"
because it is something that could never happen, to grow an organ that they said would never be there.
So I placed my intention, praying, "Mother, make me a witness to your apparition through this."
Now, my main intention, as Father says, is that the Catholic Church must approve our Mother's apparition.
That is my foremost intention,
followed by everyone being filled with the Holy Spirit, and for the needs of those around us.
Only after all that, at the very end, do I place any personal intentions I might have.
Before, I used to be so afraid of everything, wondering what would happen and how.
But now, no matter what problem comes, I have this courage that Jesus will take care of it,
and that Mother Mary is with me, and what Mother Mary has done in my life is truly a great mercy of God.
For this great mercy I received through Mother's Intercession, I say a thousand thanks to Mother Mary.
The Holy Gospel of John, chapter 16, verse 24, says,
"Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete."
Neethu has shared her testimony of God's experience very clearly with us.
She shared about going abroad, and while she was working in home care in the UK, she found out she was pregnant.
Working in home care there is not a very comfortable situation,
as it involves a lot of traveling, moving from one home care to another.
Under these circumstances, it wasn't that she didn't want the baby, but the thought came to her that it was an unexpected time.
Along with that, this daughter comes to know from the scan that the baby does not have a right kidney.
She is a daughter who went abroad after making the Covenant in her life,
and Neethu shared with us that she tried to live the Covenant life there as best as she could.
What did she do next in that situation, even when she couldn't renew the Covenant online?
Still she demonstrated her faithfulness and her conviction of leading a Covenant life.
Since the facilities for Confession were limited there, she would write down all her sins.
She would ask God for forgiveness and reconcile with Him.
That is an attitude of the mind; it doesn't mean everyone should do it exactly like this.
But when she reached a point where it seemed impossible, she didn't just give up on everything.
Her baby is growing in her womb, and she wants that baby to grow as Mother Mary's child.
She felt unable to do much, as she had her work and duties.
If she gave up her duty, it would be difficult to survive there.
In this situation, the only thing she could do was face the circumstances ahead.
For that, she looked for ways to draw closer to Jesus, wanting to complete Mother's Covenant life with more faithfulness.
Reverend Father VP Joseph once said during the Covenant retreats that there must be times in our lives when we stand alone for Christ.
At least once a month, we must experience a situation where no one is with us, and we are completely alone.
It is in this situation that we hold on to God.
No matter who is there in life, be it a husband or parents, no one could truly stand with this daughter in her situation.
She had to live through it herself; she was pregnant, and the baby had to grow in her womb for nine months.
She was the only one going through it,
but in these isolating circumstances, she held on to God, and that is what she did through the Covenant.
She tried her maximum to be more faithful to her Covenant life.
Later on, using the blessed covenant items she received, she prayed over her womb for her unborn son.
After that, all the scans still showed that there was no right kidney, and until then, she hadn't seen any testimony about a missing organ growing.
However, seeing her faith and faithfulness, God allowed this daughter to witness a testimony to nourish her faith even more.
She saw a testimony about how a baby without a uterus received one.
Seeing that as a grace received solely through the Covenant, her faith increased, and she began to pray with even more zeal.
She brought the Kreupasanam newsletter from here and distributed it to others.
Since she couldn't go out to work, she read the Bible to the patients she had in the UK.
She took the time to read the Kreupasanam newsletter for them as well.
Even amidst the difficulties of her pregnancy, this daughter did not just sit idle somewhere.
She wanted her baby in full health, and for that, she realized she had to endure hardships and become an instrument for God.
Thus, this daughter proved her faithfulness in her life going forward.
Then we hear that after the delivery, during the baby's scan, the only result coming was that the baby had no right kidney.
